The '''Moddell Reach''' was one of the two only [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]], before the creation of the [[Sanctuary Pipeline/Legends|Sanctuary Pipeline]], to connect the remote [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

Like the [[Spar Trade Route/Legends|Spar Trade Route]], the route ran from the [[Cerean Reach/Legends|Cerean Reach]] to [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] and the Moddell sector.<ref name="TEA" />
